name: Dynamic Skills & Automation Engine
purpose: Dynamic skill catalog discovery, parsing, certification, zero-trust authorization, sandboxed execution, and learning integration.
registration: AbilityEngine coordinates discovery, practice, acquisition, and skill evolution across SkillEngine and ToolRegistry; SkillEngine::load_catalog reads CATALOG.json; SkillCertificationAuthority::register_skill registers verified skill specs.
discovery: AbilityEngine::discover queries all registries; SkillEngine::discover_skills queries catalog; ToolRegistry matches tool signatures requested by NLU or control tokens.
execution: SkillEngine::execute_skill passes audited arguments to category dispatchers (coding, android, data, research, multimedia).
memory_link: Skill execution inputs, outputs, and latency are recorded in episodic memory via MemoryEngine::record_episode.
learning_link: Successful tool use patterns feed into UserSearchLearner and CapabilitySynthesizer for skill enhancement.
self_evolution_link: ContinualLearningGovernor identifies skill usage gaps; CapabilitySynthesizer proposes composite skills.
curriculum_link: Academic coding and tool-use records in master_curriculum.jsonl teach control-token skill invocations.
safety_gates: SkillCertificationAuthority checks SPDX license and authority
Category sandbox isolation blocks host destruction

lifecycle.1_define: Skill manifest defined in TARA/SKILLS/<category>/<name>/ with README and spec
lifecycle.2_register: SkillEngine::load_catalog indexes skill into SkillCatalog and ToolRegistry
lifecycle.3_discover: Brain NLU or control-token parser matches user intent to registered skill
lifecycle.4_authorize: ExecutionGuard and SkillCertificationAuthority verify caller authority and safety rules
lifecycle.5_execute: Category dispatcher executes logic in isolated sandbox environment
lifecycle.6_store: Result persisted in execution trace and session context
lifecycle.7_learn: Memory episode created; patterns analyzed by CapabilitySynthesizer
lifecycle.8_evolve: Composite skill synthesis and adaptive parameter refinement
lifecycle.9_test: Automated unit tests in skills/certification.rs verify certification lifecycle
